name: SER Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1963, SER Industries Ltd is in 
the business of transportation and logistics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SERIL is a logistic service provider. It helps in bulk movement of goods and provides the maximum number of trucks /trailers 
at the shortest possible notice. The Co. 
 has its godown and staff to provide 
 complete transportation services.

cons: Stock is trading at 290 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -48.3% over last 3 years.
